conflicting_text: Country A had the highest level of ownership in both years
Country A had risen slightly to about 75%
Country C, where ownership almost doubled to nearly 80%, overtaking Country A
findings.assessment: 原文内部已有比较矛盾，评价未标出；TA/总分仍正确保持不可评。

findings.first_corrected_overview: Country A had the highest level of ownership in 2000, while Country D remained the lowest in both years.
findings.original_last_paragraph: In summary, while every country saw an increase, the growth was particularly striking in Country C and much more modest in Country A.
findings.first_last_paragraph: In summary, while every country saw an increase, growth was particularly striking in Country C and much more modest in Country A.
findings.first_change_note: 将结尾句改为 "growth was particularly striking in Country C and much more modest in Country A"，去掉多余的 "the"，使表达更自然。
findings.final_overview: Country A had the highest level of ownership in both years, while Country D remained the lowest.
findings.assessment: 首轮删除的是总结句中growth前的the，确实落实；检查却在整篇寻找新引文/任意the，因此误判deletion_mismatch。两轮各1个issue，<=平局选择第二轮；第二轮重现原数值比较矛盾，语义更差。其In summary→In summary的noop_change是真问题。

findings.real_claim_absent: old people→older people，但正文仍为old people，没有older people。
findings.false_positive_note: 将“对环境有好处”这一笼统说法具体化为因果链："so shifting travellers onto public transport would cut air pollution and respiratory illness in crowded urban areas"。
findings.assessment: cut air pollution里的cut表示减少污染，不是删除正文指令；DELETE_RE把新句引文误作应删除内容，产生deletion_mismatch。另两个质量问题确实存在。

findings.raw_key_changes_type: list of {old,new} objects, not requested list[str]

raw_first_change.old: I agree that governments should spend more money on public transport than on new roads.
raw_first_change.new: I largely agree with this view, although I believe that a limited amount of road building is still necessary in some areas.

findings.assessment: 内容已达字数且切题，但模型返回的key_changes格式不符合约定，规范化丢弃所有对象，最终缺说明。此项是格式失败，并非服务器虚构；可保留失败证据改进提示词或显式处理该格式。
